title: Folio Assistant platform terms (cat-harness)
description: Terms the platform introduced in September 2026, each defined where its schema defines it and linked to the W3C concept it corresponds to, rather than copying that concept's definition. These are the platform terms whose source is in cat-harness, so they are minted in cat-harness's namespace (owner, 2026-09-24: a term lives in the namespace of the instance that owns its source). The file sits in core's glossary directory, which is the only one declared; where it sits does not decide whose it is.

terms.definition: A harness this one knows by name, site and repository, and never loads, builds or copies. The fourth relation beside depends (needs), references (remoteGraphs) and utilizes (dependencies).
Which Actor may do which action, and where, written as W3C ODRL 2.2 permission and prohibition rules scoped by Process, Task and Role.
One ODRL rule allowing an assignee an action, optionally on a target and within constraints. A permission to a broader action permits every action included in it.
One performance of a BPMN task by an Actor in a Role under a policy, recorded as a W3C PROV-O activity whose plan is the task.
A concrete participant, human, agentic or mechanical, that persists across every process and takes on roles. Which login is which actor is the data store's to know.
The swimlane: a persona an actor takes on because of the lane it is acting in, carrying the skills that lane's activities need.
What a reader acting in a Role is trying to do, told as that role: as a <role>, I want <want>, so that <so that>. The story points at its role; the role names no story.

One measurement of a Skill: which skill it tests, the cases it exercised, and a hash of the data and a hash of the process that produced the result, so a third party can redo it. Its cases are checked against the skill's input and output contracts.
A named set of writing rules for prose, active in the roles and processes it names. The voice points at the role it is written for; the role names no voice.
A record of a specification the platform depends on but does not hold: which authority publishes it, which version is conformed to, and the operative terms used from it.
A committed QA sidecar recording, for one knowledge-graph subject such as a process, role or skill, which of its references fail to resolve under each audit criterion.
One person's outstanding work, as a content node the folio owns, tagged with the roles, processes and tasks it concerns. Not the agent work plan, which is beans.
One item of the agent work plan, held by the beans CLI in the committed beans/ store, with a status, a parent and the beans it blocks.
A JSON document that describes the shape of other JSON documents. In the platform, a node schema and a skill's input and output contracts are each a JSON Schema file.
